appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Interior wide of the central dome as shards fly: show the creature (consistent design: stitched vinyl + backlit plates + new shard crown), people in mid-throw, glass dome with spiderweb cracks, scattered reflective tag-shards catching the light. Tension in composition, dramatic rim light on shards.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: 5s dynamic sequence: quick cuts of thrown packs erupting into arcs of shrapnel, shards embedding and glinting in stone, the creature catching and assembling them into a crown; the dome trembles and cracks. Keep the creature visually consistent with earlier appearance.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the crown is formed and the dome shudders, push in to a close-up on the crown on the creature's head, then pull back to reveal the cracked dome and scattered shards.

appliedScenePlan.title: Market of Shards
appliedScenePlan.event: The creature feeds its crown-shards into a small vending module that unfolds from its torso; the shards are compressed and extruded as small coin-like tokens and tiny packaged goods. Kiosks at the cleared channel whirl to life, accepting shards as currency; people step forward exchanging tokens for neat consumer items. The Kaufhaus reorganizes; the dome crack's web glitters like mosaic tile as commodities flow out on a narrow conveyor toward the service exit. The specific rule enacted: the economic logic of goods (Konsum) converts violent residue into exchangeable commodities — violence is made into items and circulated.
appliedScenePlan.consequence: A conveyor of converted tokens and packaged goods moves through the cleared channel out toward the service door; the central dome now reads as a reflective mosaic of shard-tiles.
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: The conveyor carrying transformed tokens exits the Kaufhaus, leaving the atrium repatterned into a commodity mosaic and a still, empty central space.
appliedScenePlan.stillPrompt: Short, intimate shot of the creature operating a small vending mechanism built into its torso: it feeds shard-fragments and receives smooth coin-like tokens; nearby kiosks accept the tokens and hand out packaged goods. The Kaufhaus architecture (dome, mezzanine, tile mosaic) is visible; lighting is warm and transactional.
appliedScenePlan.videoPrompt: 2s concise action: the creature slots the last shard, a token drops onto the conveyor, people collect small packaged goods and step aside as the conveyor carries tokens out. Emphasize quick, tactile movements, the clink of tokens, reflective mosaic in dome.
appliedScenePlan.cameraCue: After the final token drops, pull the camera back in a short crane to show the conveyor exiting through the service door and the atrium left as a patterned, empty market.
